description: Somos la Generacion Espacial de Lima, Zarate, BA, Argentina. Desde nuestro pueblo miramos al espacio. Equipo abierto de GIS, mapeo y datos NASA. Buscamos devs, diseñadores, estudiantes y curiosos. No hace falta experiencia, solo ganas. ¡Mision: llevar a Lima al mundo!
summary:
Our project DUST SHIELD ATACAMA proposes a solution to protect equipment and habitats from lunar and Martian dust, inspired by the Atacama Desert as a Mars analog.

We developed a protective shield with anti-static materials and a cleaning system using vibration and filtered air, which prevents dust from damaging solar panels, suits, and sensors.

We addressed the NASA Space Apps Challenge by combining scientific research, design in Canva, and data from NASA and CONAE. It is important because space dust is one of the biggest risks for future missions to the Moon and Mars.
details:
DUST SHIELD ATACAMA is a protective system designed to solve the problem of space dust on the Moon and Mars.

The problem: fine dust sticks to everything, damages solar panels, spacesuits, and sensors, and can affect astronauts' health.

Our solution: an anti-static shield combined with a cleaning system based on vibration and filtered air. We used the Atacama Desert as a reference, because its extreme conditions are similar to Mars.

We used NASA data, CONAE information, Canva for design, and AI tools for idea generation and research.

This project helps make future space missions safer, longer, and more efficient.
